title: Material Blend 3-Mix Solo #20 (목재+보태니컬+나비날개비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks dominates zone 1. living sakura blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING PINK blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils dominates zone 2. butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 3. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
